title: It’s a TRAP! Task-Redirecting Agent Persuasion Benchmark for Web Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on the security and robustness of LLM-based agents against prompt injection and social-engineering persuasion techniques. While it includes an 'Ethics Statement' and uses policy-violating content as a redirection target, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks as a core component of its benchmarking.
